purpose: lists, activates, or deactivates the packages this repository takes

list.description: prints every package in reach, with a ✅ beside the active ones and a ❌ beside the excluded ones, its origin (release or repository), and its description. This is the default.

select.description: makes exactly the named packages, with the packages they depend on and the members they include, the active set: it removes what the set omits, adds what it lacks, and says which active package it kept for another's sake; with nothing to change it says the set

add.description: activates the packages, the packages they depend on, and the members they include, places the files they deliver, and rewrites the manifests. When a different file is already at a delivered path, it is named and left alone, and no manifest is written. A package named here is no longer excluded.

remove.description: takes out what the packages delivered (files, the kit's JSON entries, and the kit's regions) and rewrites the manifests. A package that an active package depends on is refused. A member of a bundle that stays active is recorded as excluded, so that kit update does not bring it back.

<package>.description: a package's name, such as style/bash, or a glob over names, such as 'style/*'; each must be in the release or under .kit/packages/
